text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was almost certainly not a deciding factor. Raising the panel's all-female composition lacks any factual or legal basis and would severely damage your professional reputation. 

Head of group roles frequently weigh business development and client relationships—explicitly highlighted in the announcement—over purely technical tenure. If any unfair bias occurred, it would more plausibly relate to age or salary expectations rather than sex, but it is far more likely a straightforward assessment of client-facing leadership fit. 

Send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused purely on developmental areas and interview performance rather than questioning the panel's makeup.
